p1_why: under the linear closure carry = (1-g_u)*s_M with 1-g_u = 1 - Q_u/V_u = S_post/V_u, which IS the retained water fraction. So -ln(carry) = -ln(S_post/V_u) - ln(s_M), and ln(s_M) is negligible against the O(1) water terms. The N memory lifetime is the upper store water residence time BY CONSTRUCTION, not by measurement.
